changelog:
v2.24.0 例句全面整改 + 拓展页滚动位置记忆

【例句修复】
- 替换96条占位符例句（frequently/appears in gaokao exams）为真实考点语境例句
- 重写82条同义词循环定义（Both X and Y mean Y）为同时使用两个词的真实对比例句
- 重写40条易混词模板例句（Be careful to distinguish）为真实辨析语境例句
- 修复60条机器翻译错误（褒贬词误译、拼写错误词乱译、易混词无释义）
- 修复985词汇中模板例句（The interview covered several topics related to...）
- 修正多处撇号转义、截断句子、缺失翻译等问题

【体验优化】
- 拓展页跳转其他界面后返回时，保持之前浏览的滚动位置，不再回到顶部
devNotes: fix ~280 example sentences across seedWordsExam/seedSynonyms/seedConfused/seedDualSentiment/seedMisspelled/seedPhrases; replace template placeholders with real exam-context sentences; rewrite circular synonym definitions; rewrite confused word template examples; fix machine translation errors in dual sentiment/misspelled/confused sections; fix unescaped apostrophes in data strings; add extendScrollRef + prevSectionRef for extension page scroll position memory
